displayName: Enrich a lead list with decision-maker contacts
summary: Find the right contact at every company on your list.

useCases.title: Enrich a lead list with decision-maker contacts
useCases.message: I have a list of companies I'm targeting. Ask me for the company list. You might want to figure out which title makes the best decision-maker based on what you know about my ICP. Then find the right contact at each company and add their name, title, and LinkedIn URL to a Google Sheet or Notion.
